title: interview.session_ready.v1
description: The session bundle is composed and immutable. Nothing about the session may change after this, which is what makes a review reproducible, so the digest is carried for anyone who needs to prove which inputs were used.

bundle_digest.description: Digest of the bundle's content. A material pre-start change creates a new revision with a new digest rather than editing this one.

bundle_revision.description: Which revision this is. Greater than one means the session was recomposed before it started.
